tools.name: search_gondi
tools.description:
Find collections, artists, NFTs and users on GONDI by name. Call it
first whenever you have a name rather than a slug: never guess a slug,
take it from the result. Each match carries its slug or address, its
chain where it has one, and gondi_url, its GONDI page to hand the
user.

query.description: A name or part of one, a slug, a token id, an ENS name or a contract or wallet address.
query.title: Query

limit.description: Results to answer per kind, 1 to 15.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_collection_market
tools.description:
A collection's prices on GONDI: its floor price and its top
collection bid, each in its currency and in USD, and what selling and
buying its NFTs costs in fees on GONDI against OpenSea. Answers "what
is the floor of X", "what's the top bid on X collection" and "where do
I pay the lowest fees to sell X". It takes a slug:
when you have a name, call search_gondi first and take the slug from
its result.

tools.name: get_nft_market
tools.description:
One NFT's prices on GONDI: what it is listed for, the top bid on
it, its last sale, its estimated value and whether it is collateral in
an open loan, and what the seller nets selling at the listing's price
or into the top bid on GONDI against OpenSea. Answers "what's this NFT
listed for", "what's the top bid on Y" and "what do I keep if I accept
it". It takes a collection slug and a token id: when you have a
name, call search_gondi first and take both from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

tools.name: list_cheapest_for_sale
tools.description:
The cheapest NFTs for sale on GONDI from one collection or by one
artist, cheapest first: each with its listing price in its currency
and in USD, the marketplace it is listed on and gondi_url, the page
where the user buys it. Answers "what's the cheapest NFT from this
collection" and "what's the cheapest NFT from this artist". Pass
exactly one of collection_slug and artist_slug: when you have a name,
call search_gondi first and take the slug from its result. A
collection's list counts its wrapped versions and the vaults holding
its NFTs, as its GONDI page does; each row names the collection it is
in.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection to list.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

artist_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the artist to list.
artist_slug.title: Artist Slug

tools.name: list_recent_sales
tools.description:
The latest sales of a collection, or of one NFT when token_id is
set, newest first: each with its price in its currency and in USD at
the time of the sale, the marketplace, when it sold, the NFT, the
seller and buyer, the transaction hash and gondi_url, the NFT's page.
A summary counts the sales of the period and gives the min, median and
max USD price of those listed. Answers "what did X sell for recently?"
and "what did this NFT last sell for?". A collection's sales include
its wrapped versions', as its GONDI page does. It takes a collection
slug and a token id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first and
take them from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: Only this NFT's sales: its token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

period.description: Only the sales of this last stretch; every sale if unset.
period.title: Period

tools.name: get_floor_price_history
tools.description:
A collection's floor price over time in ETH, one point a day (at
most 31, evenly spaced over a long period), with the floor at the
start and now and the change between them in percent. Answers "how
has the floor of X moved?". It takes a slug: when you have a name,
call search_gondi first and take the slug from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

tools.name: list_top_collections
tools.description:
The top and trending NFT collections on GONDI right now, ranked as
GONDI's collections table ranks them: each with its floor price in its
currency and in USD, the floor's change, the volume traded and the
number of sales over the period, and gondi_url, its page. Answers "what
are the top NFT collections", "what's trending" and "which collections
sold the most this week". A collection and its wrappers (CryptoPunks and
its wrapped forms) are one row, under the collection they wrap; user
vaults, hidden collections and shared contracts that mint many artists'
works (SuperRare, Foundation) are left out.

sort_by.description: VOLUME and SALES rank by the period's traded volume and sale count. TRENDING, GONDI's Trending, ranks by how far the last day's volume runs above the week's daily average, whatever the period. MARKET_CAP, GONDI's Top, ranks by floor times supply. FLOOR_CHANGE ranks by the period's floor change. Highest first.
sort_by.title: Sort By

period.description: The window volume, sales and floor change cover.
period.title: Period

chain.description: Only this chain; every chain if unset.

tools.name: get_lending_market_overview
tools.description:
Snapshot of the whole GONDI lending market in USD: open principal,
interest paid to and accruing for lenders, and per rolling window the
principal originated and the effective APR quartiles of new loans.

tools.name: get_supported_markets
tools.description:
Where and how GONDI lends: per chain the MultiSourceLoan contract to
approve and the principal currencies with their decimals, plus the
loan offer duration rule (any whole multiple of 30 days up to a maximum,
or one of a few short durations) and the protocol fee on interest.

tools.name: get_lending_guide
tools.description:
How lending on GONDI works, step by step, with its risks and the
units these tools answer in. Read it before advising a lender.

tools.name: list_lending_opportunities
tools.description:
Collections borrowers take loans against, ranked: open loans and
principal, repayment rate, floor price and how many offers lenders
already hold, and gondi_url, its collection page. A collection and its
wrappers (CryptoPunks and its wrapped forms) are one row, under the
collection they wrap. Start here to find where to lend.

chain.description: Only this chain; every chain if unset.

currency.description: Count offers in this principal currency only; implies its chain. Ranking and outstanding principal cover every currency.
currency.title: Currency

tools.name: get_collection_lending_stats
tools.description:
One collection's lending picture: floor price, open loans, repayment
rate, how much is lent against it (outstanding principal in one currency
and in USD across all, and principal lent all time and over 30 days),
and the principal, APR and remaining-time ranges of its open loans in
that currency. It counts the collection's wrap family together: the
naked collection and the collections that wrap its NFTs one for one
(cryptopunks with wrapped-cryptopunks and cryptopunks-721), whichever
of them the slug names. Any other collection is not included, even one
with a similar name: CryptoPunks V1 (wrapped), official-v1-punks, has
its own stats under its own slug. Use it to answer how much has been
lent against a collection, or to price an offer on it.

currency.description: The chain's wrapped native token if unset.
currency.title: Currency

tools.name: list_loan_offers
tools.description:
Active, public loan offers lenders have signed: what they lend, at
which APR and for how long, against which collection or NFT, with
gondi_url, the page where a borrower takes it (the NFT's lending section
for a single-NFT offer, else the collection's Loan Offers tab). These
are the terms a new offer competes with. Every kind of offer ranks
together, so a row with a token_id is a loan only that NFT can take:
say which NFT it is on. For a borrower, offer_type CollectionOffer with
sort_by APR_BPS and order ASC answers the cheapest loan any NFT of a
collection can take.

collection_slug.description: Only offers on this collection: its collection, trait and set offers and the offers on each of its NFTs.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

offer_type.description: Only this kind of offer: CollectionOffer, which any NFT of the collection can take, or SingleNFTOffer, which only the NFT in token_id can. Every kind if unset.
offer_type.title: Offer Type

chain.description: Only this chain; every chain if unset.

currency.description: Only this principal currency; implies its chain.
currency.title: Currency

order.description: DESC ranks highest or newest first, ASC lowest or oldest first.
order.title: Order

tools.name: get_top_lenders
tools.description:
The leading GONDI lenders over a rolling period, with their open
principal, earnings, net effective APR and default rate, and gondi_url,
the lender's profile on its Lent tab: a benchmark for what lending here
returns.

metric.description: LOWEST_DEFAULT_RATE ranks lowest first, the rest highest first.

currency.description: Rank in this currency; every currency in USD if unset.
currency.title: Currency

tools.name: get_lender_returns
tools.description:
One wallet's lending record, found by address, GONDI username or ENS
name: per currency the principal lent, realised net profit, weighted net
APR, the principal of its defaulted positions, and its open positions
with the interest they are still due to earn, and gondi_url, the
wallet's profile on its Lent tab, which lists those positions. Leave
`currency` unset to get every currency the wallet lent in from one call;
no need to resolve the name or to try the currencies one by one.

wallet.description: The lender: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

currency.description: Only this principal currency; every currency the wallet ever lent in if unset.
currency.title: Currency

tools.name: list_borrower_loans
tools.description:
A borrower's open loans on GONDI, found by address, GONDI username or
ENS name; pass the name or address the user gives as `wallet`, no need
to resolve it first. Per loan: the NFT, principal in its currency and
in USD, APR, start and due date, days left, the repayment due at
expiry, whether it is in its end lockup, the pending renegotiation
offers on it and GONDI's best market loan offer on its NFT, each with
its net principal and its APR against the loan's. Answers "what are my
expiring loans?" (expiring_within_days, soonest due first;
matching_loan_count is how many are due in the window, whatever
`limit`) and "what should I renegotiate?" (sort_by REFINANCE_SAVING:
the loans a cheaper offer waits for first). open_loan_count is every
open loan of the wallet. `summary` counts and totals every matching
loan, not only the rows returned: principal and repayment per
currency, overdue and end-lockup counts, and loans and repayment per
due day. Answer "how many, how much, which days" from it, and to list
more loans call again with offset=next_offset; never send the user to
the site for the loans a page left out. To repay, accept a
renegotiation or refinance, send the user to the loan's gondi_url, its
NFT's page on GONDI.

wallet.description: The borrower: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

expiring_within_days.description: Only the loans due within this many days, overdue ones included; every open loan if unset.
expiring_within_days.title: Expiring Within Days

sort_by.description: DUE_DATE: soonest due first. REFINANCE_SAVING: the largest APR cut on offer first, ranked over every matching loan up to the 300 soonest due (ranked_loan_count says how many).
sort_by.title: Sort By

offset.description: Skip this many loans of the sort: pass the previous answer's next_offset for the next page.
offset.title: Offset

tools.name: list_borrowing_opportunities
tools.description:
What a wallet can borrow against on GONDI right now: the NFTs it
holds in its wallet, stash or vaults and not already in a loan, with
the largest loan offer each can take today (net principal, APR,
duration, origination fee, loan-to-floor and expiry), the one GONDI's
Borrow page shows. NFTs sharing that offer, such as a collection offer
on several of them, come as one opportunity listing them with their
gondi_url (the page where the user borrows) and fundable_count, how
many of them the offer can still fund, one loan each: say "19 Miladies;
one offer can fund 3 of them". limit counts offers, not NFTs. Answers
"what can I borrow against my NFTs?". For the cheapest loan on one
collection, call list_loan_offers with offer_type CollectionOffer,
sort_by APR_BPS and order ASC.

wallet.description: The borrower: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet

currency.description: Only offers in this principal currency; any if unset.
currency.title: Currency

sort_by.description: PRINCIPAL ranks the most you can borrow first, in USD; APR the cheapest offer first.
sort_by.title: Sort By

tools.name: get_borrow_quote
tools.description:
How much can be borrowed against one NFT on GONDI right now,
whoever holds it: the largest loan offer it can take (net principal,
APR, duration, origination fee, loan-to-floor and expiry) and the
cheapest-APR offer when that is another one, with gondi_url, the NFT's
page where its owner borrows. Answers "how much can I borrow against
X #N". To weigh selling the NFT against borrowing on it, call
get_nft_market too and follow the lending guide's "sell or borrow"
paragraph. A wrapped CryptoPunk is quoted on the offers of its
CryptoPunk, which it borrows on. It takes a collection slug and a
token id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

currency.description: Only offers in this principal currency; any if unset.
currency.title: Currency

tools.name: get_buy_with_loan_quote
tools.description:
What buying a listed NFT with a loan (buy now, pay later) costs on
GONDI, as its Buy with Loan button quotes it: the listing, the loan
offer that finances it, the upfront payment from the buyer's wallet,
the loan's principal, APR, duration, interest and repayment at expiry,
and GONDI's Buy with Loan fee. The NFT is collateral until the loan is
repaid; unpaid at expiry, the lender takes it. When the NFT is not
listed or no offer can finance it, unavailable_reason says why. Loans
to US buyers run 28 days at most. Send
the user to gondi_url to buy. It takes a collection slug and a token
id: when you have a name, call search_gondi first.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the NFT's collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

token_id.description: The NFT's token id, as a decimal string.
token_id.title: Token Id

tools.name: get_wallet_holdings
tools.description:
What a wallet's NFTs are worth and what it holds: the estimated value
of all its NFTs in ETH and USD, the one its GONDI profile shows, with
how many it holds in its wallet, stashes and vaults and as collateral
of its loans, and its most valuable collections with their floor, count
and value. It adds the principal the wallet owes as borrower, so you can
state its net value. Answers "what is my wallet worth?" and "what NFTs
do I hold?". limit counts collections. To borrow against these NFTs,
call list_borrowing_opportunities; for the wallet's loans, call
list_borrower_loans.

wallet.description: The holder: a 0x address, a GONDI username or an ENS name (vitalik.eth).
wallet.title: Wallet
